assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
The symptoms raise concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks.
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction.
The study is being performed to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of the transient cerebral ischemic events.
The study is being performed to guide anticoagulation management.
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered.
The payer denied the claim under denial code CO-97.
The payer stated that the documentation fails to demonstrate that less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient prior to initiating this level of care.
